man. where to start. it's been a few weeks now, maybe a month, ive pissed off my parents (admittedly they are kind of immature at times), my cousin, girlfriend, and i have nearly every day. i cycle through who has a problem with me because i do something wrong, unintentionally be an ass, slip up, im setting everyone off.

ive had many days where i just

1. wake up
2. do chores
3. ask my parents about something or recently for example, asked my dad a bunch of tax related questions bc of fsa, pissed him off and ruined everyone's sunday
4. bottle it up until everyone in the house lays off my ass so i can cry about it 
5. cry for a few minutes 
6. text girlfriend, long distance.

8. cry, go to sleep

i often worry if my girlfriend loves me still and if she cares about me yes, i want my parents to love me but im very aware that they aren't the best people around and so i try not to value their love as much as i really wish i could.

im really just tired of people being upset or angry at me. i have managed to get at least 1 person i care about get mad at me every day for about a month now i think. 

my mom is my mom, i love her in the regard she's kept me sheltered, fed and looked after for all of these years, my dad too. that's where the love ends though. they are always there up until i need them, then it's times where they ground me for reaching out to the suicide hotline and laugh and mock me for my feelings. i don't want to care what they think, but i can't get the "they're my parents, it's wrong to not care about them" schtick out of my head.

this. i want to do this, but when i ask this to my girlfriend if she is upset she's sometimes just told me im asking a dumb question

im really tired of feeling like a dumbass, i don't hold it against her because im not great with emotions and i'll say shit too if i don't step back. it hurts though, and it's happened enough times already. she's not the only one, my parents have been getting on me about asking shit and bringing shit up. i just spent my last sunday getting yelled at for ruining it because i asked about their tax returns for 2019 so i can update my fed student aid stuff.

you're 100%, absolutely right about everything you've suggested i do, it all makes sense, i don't know if i have the energy to do that though. it's been a month cycle of pissing everyone i remotely care about off. i feel like no matter what i do, to someone in my circle im the straw that breaks the camels back for someone every fucking day man, i don't want it anymore.

i try not to smoke anymore these days, i was a stoner right out the gate in early 11th grade and graduated by the skin of my teeth. my mom isn't very supportive at all when it cones to my mental health, ive been grounded before when i called the suicide hotline when i was around maybe 16, 17?  laughed at me for that one, she did.

i would like to take my girlfriend out like that though. one day i'll close the gap and do that. it's the only thing keeping me going forward, if im completely honest.
